question: does the frozen gate's short side keep a positive hedged mean when the resampling null preserves the volatility regime observed at entry?

conditioning.variable: DVOL close last available at entry (same availability convention as the daily marks)
conditioning.rule: block start days whose previous available DVOL close lies within tolerance of the entry DVOL
conditioning.note: tolerance widens by the step until min_eligible_starts is met; the final tolerance per entry is recorded in the artifact

book.expression: short ATM straddle, daily delta hedge with the inverse perp, hold to expiry
book.entry_fill: crossed bid (conservative floor from the Phase 2 study)
book.funding: mean realized hourly rate over the cached hedge windows
book.margin: standard Deribit maintenance approximation from Phase 3

evaluation.primary: pooled mean hedged P&L of the gate 'short' entries under the conditioned null
secondary: pooled mean of all 22 entries and of the gate 'long' entries
per-entry means vs the unconditional Phase 3 run
Kelly and sizing grid restricted to the gate 'short' pool
evaluation.success_criterion: gate-short pooled mean > 0 under the conditioned null; failure sends the strategy back to forecast research before any capital
